# Returnable selector stage of the connected runtime replacement

Base commit `4a66148b7596dbf693c8d305dbc4c9278a4ef751`, base bot `local_economic_topology_01`. Candidate `bots/pi_economic-service-budget-stage-01/` only. Implement in C++. This is one intermediate source stage of the existing complete-strategy runtime design, not a replacement for that design or a strength candidate.

## Why this stage

The full economic strategy exists but its eager capture and exhaustive service selector prevent useful action. The connected-runtime Pi job explicitly timed out without publishing source. Do not recover, search for or copy that checkout. Build this bounded stage from the exact base above. The PC will independently handle the observation integration; the finished connected pipeline must still meet every existing safety, receipt, activity, resource, construction and direct-champion gate.

Source/research: `economic_service.cpp` currently evaluates multi-operation continuations and large per-endpoint plans even for a quiet walk. The PC's frozen SDK-free benchmark measures199108 Wasmtime instructions for a synthetic106-member quiet contact and188300 for49-member passive work; those are not game fuel. Actual leader Islands Vesper uses basic/reset/basic, and dash then walk, while capture/own receipts differ from clear credit. Vault leaders finish the49-member reward before40 with no purchases. We need cheap useful decisions without deleting those capabilities.

## Exact scope and interface

Add `src/economic_service_budget.h`, `src/economic_service_budget.cpp`, `tests/economic_service_budget.cpp`, and write the candidate's `IMPLEMENTATION.md`. Apart from replacing that report, leave every inherited file byte-identical, including the old selector, its tests, Scene/capture, owner, routes, recovery, banking, runtime, ledger, config, SDK, draft and shopping. Do not wire production yet: old capture is still too costly, and this stage alone cannot qualify gameplay.

Expose `ServiceChoice select_service_budget(const Scene&, ServiceIntent, const action::Ledger&)` from the new header, including the existing service header. Use the inherited **full Scene** contract in this stage. Unknown members under that contract remain unknown. Explicit sparse membership/Strength knowledge will be added by the later connected integration; do not claim this stage is safe with arbitrarily omitted rows. A missing member cannot be certified safe by this interface. Existing `ServiceChoice` permits use by the typed executor later. Its nominal_work field is not consumed by production callers: document whether it is unpopulated or describes immediate work; never label a heuristic sum as the old exact continuation objective.

## One-operation policy

Implement the new policy independently; do not call the exhaustive selector. Validate the inherited epoch/life/channel/recovery/allowance/cycle/capacity and numeric preconditions. Return one operation, or a reasoned stop. No hypothetical multi-operation enumeration, large per-endpoint plans or exact320-bit objective ranking. Use deterministic immediate damage/removal/contact priorities, then stable identity/coordinate ties. Keep ranking estimates separate from safety permission.

Retain basic, targeted damage/CC, supported AoE, attack reset, heal/shield, safe walk/dash, capture hold/compatible stationary defense and recovery handoff. A quiet retained adjacent contact needs a cheap walk without enumerating unrelated work plans. Reset can enable another basic only with an available remaining ledger allowance and an actual fresh reachable target. Repeated fresh calls must support basic/reset/basic and compatible dash/walk; this function itself returns only the next operation. Keep physical/visibility requirements and movement/exclusivity semantics. Hold a live occupied reward instead of chasing or leaving it.

Safety remains conservative: enemy response reach, awake harmful members, group-wide wake closure and every unrelated group touched by a damaging/stunning dash/AoE matter. Unknown harmful siblings block that effect even at a distant last position. One blocked landing must not disable another safe landing. Do not count proposed damage, shielding or healing as already removing a threat. Validate finite nonnegative numeric inputs; a safety sum must be exact or conservatively rounded upward, with overflow/uncertainty denying permission. Work ranking may be heuristic. Keep current caps and the shared action ledger. The existing typed live executor remains the later final preflight.

## Focused checks and prompt source return

Exercise the actual new function on: quiet walking with106members; ordinary harmful-group work;49-member passive work; basic then reset then basic with updated Scene/ledger; stationary capture defense/hold; heal/shield; legal dash then walk; incidental unknown group wake with a separate safe landing; stale epoch/channel/recovery/allowance/cycle rejection; invalid numeric values and lethal/equal-HP threat boundaries. Use existing fixture factories if useful without changing their source or assertions. State missing coverage plainly.

Run only one focused native compile/run for the new fixture. If it fails, retain the source and report the failure; do not consume the worker deadline in broad fixes, full-suite runs, benchmarks, tournaments or SDK installation. The PC performs source review and full checks. Write IMPLEMENTATION.md and finish promptly with the implemented source, supported effects, actual check command/result and unresolved gaps. Do not implement the later capture/runtime stage, search historical Pi checkouts, upload a bot, change ranked selection or claim a stronger bot.
